title: Streaming text arrives chunk by chunk
summary:
Streaming text stopped arriving all at once, three supported reasoning settings pass validation, and IDPhotoGen joined the creative directory.

Text API requests with `stream: true` now bypass the deduplication step that buffered responses. SSE chunks can arrive as they are generated, while non-streaming requests keep deduplication.

Chat completions now accept `none`, `minimal`, and `xhigh` for `reasoning_effort`, alongside the existing values.

IDPhotoGen, a community app for generating professional ID photos, was added to the creative app directory.
